items.desc: Higher duties in its biggest export market, coupled with the withdrawal of government incentives at home, are squeezing eastern Nepal’s jute industry, threatening its competitiveness, exports and jobs.

items.title: Russia and Ukraine hold US-backed talks after Trump says broad deal is possible
items.desc: Russian state news agency RIA reported the start of what is scheduled to be two days of talks, in which Trump’s envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are to mediate between the two warring sides.

items.title: Explained: Why is Sheikh Hasina’s plan to return to Bangladesh contentious?
items.desc: The former prime minister says she plans to return in December, despite a death sentence, the revocation of her travel documents and the risk of arrest.

items.title: Who is Alice Huang, the Chinese businesswoman tied to Nvidia’s CEO?

items.title: Seven held for setting off firecrackers in Rupandehi, one injured

items.title: Madhesh prepares for Chhath as families return home

items.title: Living alongside rhinos on the fringes of Chitwan
items.desc: From Nagarban to nearby settlements, rhinos regularly venture out in search of food, bringing people and wildlife into close contact and raising concerns over safety.

items.title: Nepal urges climate justice for Himalayas at COP31
items.desc: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal calls for a dedicated action plan for mountain regions and says limiting global warming to 1.5°C is critical to protecting the Himalayas.

items.title: Janakpur face must-win test against Sudurpaschim in NPL
